WebKit paints a diamond together with the square cap on the zero length subpath. SVG 2 requires only the centered square. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testPointSubpathCapsMatchExplicitShapes verifies caps against explicit WebKit rectangles and circles, including rotated and non scaling strokes. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

At the comparison backing scale, WebKit scales the point light position but leaves surfaceScale in device pixels, changing the effective light height. IJSVGPaintOrderWebKitTests/testLightingSurfaceScaleMatchesEquivalentLightHeight verifies flat surfaces against WebKit with the equivalent zero surface height and reduced light Z. IJSVGFilterTests/testLightingSurfaceHeightIsIndependentOfRenderScale checks matching sample positions at two render scales. This exception is limited to this exact fixture.

parserRefactorRegressions.note: Dedicated IJSVGSwitch node, C transform-origin tokenization using the shared length parser, C language matching, and spread-method utility reuse. MDN counts above remain from the last full corpus run.

embeddedSVGRegressionSuites.note: Renderer, WebKit image controls, and image export suites passed again after limiting viewport clipping to slice. The external SVG slice control uses an equivalent inline viewport because WebKit applies meet to that external image.

markerAndOverflowRegressionSuites.note: Nested viewport defaults, scroll and clip overflow, visible slice overflow, marker paints and clipping, and export round trips are covered. The raster visible overflow control passed on rerun using an equivalent full size reference image because WebKit clips the original despite visible overflow.

displacementRegressionSuites.note: Numerical tests cover source interpolation in both color spaces, named and implicit inputs, missing input fallback, and chained displacement results. WebKit controls cover all 16 channel pairs in both color spaces and embedded image maps with and without viewBox. Equivalent flood regions verify linear image maps because WebKit does not linearize the embedded map in the direct comparison.

lightingRegressionSuites.note: Diffuse and specular spotlight cones match WebKit at 5.5, 10, and 40 degrees. Flat surfaces at heights 1 and 15 match equivalent lowered point lights. Point and spot light samples remain stable across render scales 1 and 3.

lineCapRegressionSuites.note: Final renderer, command parsing, bounds, visibility, export, filter batching, and explicit WebKit cap controls passed after recording definite nonzero subpaths during C parsing. Ambiguous and changed geometry still uses the point subpath scan. The MDN square cap is the expected difference. Checks include degenerate curves, multiple subpaths, parser cache hits, mutable path edits, copies, replacement, dashed points, gradient paint, rotated caps, non scaling strokes, and export round trips.

filterAndTextRegressionSuites.note: All affected regression suites passed. The final text suites and both text path control tests were rerun after preserving automatic spacing for text on a path.

textBoundsRegressionSuites.note: Automatic alignment preserves the dominant baseline. Root text filter bounds use glyph cells instead of ink outlines. The displacement alpha map control now passes. The original displacement and turbulence comparisons remain active failures. Full MDN results remain 273 passed, 15 failed and 159 skipped. No tolerances changed.

styleAndTextRegressionSuites.note: Aggregate of the complete affected suite run and the final parsing and filter rerun. All 192 parsing and filter tests passed after preserving adjacent decimal values emitted by the compact transform exporter. Equivalent baseline controls and translated turbulence interior controls pass. Original MDN mismatches remain active.

mediaParsingBenchmark.method: Median of nine measured rounds after one warmup round. Whole SVG variants alternate order each round. No hardware timing threshold.
mediaParsingBenchmark.note: Whole document measurements include XML attribute parsing and viewport resolution. Media lengths reuse the shared C number scanner, unit recognition and base unit conversion. Parsed query matching performs no allocation. Styles are evaluated at initial SVG parsing time.

mediaUtilityRegressionSuites.note: Final checks after sharing number parsing between geometry lengths and media conditions. Includes physical and font relative units, exponent notation, invalid lengths, query reuse and the initial parsing benchmark.
